description: Curated, source-verified Courtside Archive game recaps. Player tokens use the same canonical College Baseball player IDs rendered by player.html.

paragraphs: [[cb-san-diego-roman-garcia|Roman Garcia]] put San Diego in front in the first with an RBI groundout that scored [[cb-san-diego-jay-schuyler|Jay Schuyler]].

San Diego broke the game open with four runs in the third. [[cb-san-diego-roman-garcia|Garcia]] singled in his second run, [[cb-san-diego-kevin-collard|Kevin Collard]]’s sacrifice fly brought home [[cb-san-diego-riley-adams|Riley Adams]], and [[cb-san-diego-brhet-bewley|Brhet Bewley]] capped the inning with a two-run single for a 5–0 lead.

[[cb-san-diego-nick-sprengel|Nick Sprengel]] carried a shutout through eight innings, allowing five hits and striking out seven. Back-to-back seventh-inning doubles by [[cb-san-diego-jay-schuyler|Schuyler]] and [[cb-san-diego-riley-adams|Adams]] made it 6–0 before [[cb-byu-colton-shaver|Colton Shaver]] hit a three-run ninth-inning homer; [[cb-san-diego-troy-conyers|Troy Conyers]] retired the final three hitters for the save.
